name: Ashgrove Linework Work Boot
description:
A classic lace-up work boot with a composite safety toe and a slip-resistant outsole rated for wet surfaces and light chemical exposure. The upper is full-grain synthetic leather with double stitching at the stress points. Ankle padding is firm but not restrictive. Available in brown and black.

Standard issue at a dozen Tier 2 job sites — electrical work, light construction, facilities maintenance. Some workers wear them off the clock too because they're simply that comfortable. Not fashionable, but not trying to be.
functionality: composite toe protection, slip and chemical-resistant sole
what_it_says: You work with your hands, you take your job seriously, and you don't dress to impress anyone.
story_hooks: A site foreman requiring Ashgroves for all crew is quietly taking a kickback from the local distributor — someone's starting to notice the markup on the safety gear budget.
A pair found at an abandoned site still has a access card tucked inside the tongue — whoever left them behind did so in a hurry.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sturdy, no-nonsense lace-up work boot with a squared-off silhouette and pronounced composite toe cap. Sits mid-calf with a utilitarian aesthetic that reads as dependable rather than trendy. The profile suggests serious labor without ornamentation.
physical_description.fit: True-to-size with a spacious toe box and firm ankle support. The cut accommodates thick socks and light augmentation work on the foot. Slightly relaxed through the midfoot for all-day wear comfort.
physical_description.primary_material: Full-grain synthetic leather upper with a rubber/composite outsole and steel-reinforced composite safety toe. The synthetic leather is treated for durability and stain resistance.
physical_description.texture: Smooth but slightly waxy synthetic leather with visible double stitching at seams and stress points. The outsole has deep tread grooves with a matte, slightly textured finish for grip. Ankle padding feels dense and structured beneath the upper.
physical_description.color_scheme: Medium brown or matte black, with lighter tan stitching visible on seams. The composite toe cap is charcoal gray. Minimal branding—a small embossed Ashgrove mark on the heel tab.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty waxed laces with brass eyelets. The lace pattern is traditional five-eyelet, allowing for quick adjustment and secure lockdown.
distinctive_features: Composite safety toe rated for impact and compression
Double stitching at heel, toe, and ankle stress points
Firm ankle padding that doesn't restrict movement
Small Ashgrove embossed logo on heel tab
Slightly scuffed or worn appearance even when new—designed to show honest use
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 functional utility. Not luxury, not budget salvage. Standard issue for skilled trades and maintenance work in corpo infrastructure.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals reliable, hands-on work. Worn by electrical technicians, construction crews, facilities maintenance staff, and industrial workers at GLMZ corpo sites. Off-duty wear suggests someone who values comfort and practicality over fashion. No subcultural affiliation—universal blue-collar.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in after first week of wear. Scuffs and minor creasing on the leather are normal and expected. Outsole shows real wear patterns from job sites. Laces may be re-tied frequently. No major damage if properly maintained.
